headline: Large User Grid Cost Shifting
short_summary: This bill shifts the financial burden of grid infrastructure costs from residential ratepayers to large energy users, primarily data centers, to ensure they pay their fair share.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP1123) on 2026-05-14
supporters: Residential consumer advocates, environmental groups, some state lawmakers, Dominion Energy.
news_headline: $207B Virginia Budget with Landmark Data Center Tax
news_summary: Virginia's new $207 billion budget includes a groundbreaking electricity consumption tax on data centers, aiming to ensure the industry pays its fair share and prevents residential bill increases. This legislation, including HB 1393, mandates data centers drawing 25 megawatts or more to cover their grid expansion costs.

headline: Data Center Water Use Reporting
short_summary: This bill requires water utilities to report data centers' water consumption to the State Water Control Board, increasing transparency on their environmental impact.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP0896) on 2026-04-13
supporters: Environmental groups, local governments, water conservation advocates, Senator Kannan Srinivasan.
news_headline: New Virginia law requires data center water usage be made public
news_summary: A new Virginia law, championed by Senator Kannan Srinivasan, mandates local water authorities to publicly report data center water usage. This aims to provide transparency on the industry's water consumption, which has been a growing concern for environmental advocates.

headline: Data Center Siting and Noise
short_summary: This bill establishes a permit process for high energy use facilities, requiring site assessments for noise impact on nearby residential areas and schools.
status: Last Action: Incorporated by Counties, Cities and Towns (HB153-Thomas) (Voice Vote) on 2026-01-23
supporters: Local residents, community groups, environmental advocates, Del. Josh Thomas.
opponents: Data center developers, real estate industry.
news_headline: Virginia Budget Mandates Data Center Noise Regulations
news_summary: Virginia's new budget includes provisions mandating the Department of Environmental Quality to regulate data centers' noise levels for the first time. By 2029, DEQ must set a noise standard for the industry, with violations incurring significant daily fines starting in 2030.
